$comment: BriteBase brand-token snapshot — the in-repo, hermetic design-system source consumed by the rapid-asset-design deck-template generator (build_deck_template.py) and mirrored by the skill's {brand_tokens} block. SYNCED FROM the BriteBase Design System (claude.ai/design) -> colors_and_type.css. Re-sync via the /design-sync skill (get_file colors_and_type.css) when the DS changes; do not hand-drift this file from the DS.
entity_default_note: All 27 physical-lighting verticals are Brite Nites customers; Brite Labs is a separate entity and is not covered by these deck templates.
primary_role: Brite orange — accents, the primary CTA, and the focus ring; not large fills.
saturation_rule: orange #ff4d00 is the ONLY saturated color on a light monochrome base
surfaces_note: Light, low-contrast, monochrome base. A dark #0b0b0b hero is an allowed deck-only extension.
fonts_note: Geist for body; Geist Mono for eyebrows/labels (uppercase, letter-spaced); MagdaClean for the display 'Base' wordmark. MagdaClean is licensed and ships as fonts/MagdaClean.woff2 — if it can't be embedded, fall back to Geist with MagdaClean's letter-spacing and flag the substitution.

logo.lockup: brite·base — 'Brite' in Geist 600 + 'Base' in MagdaClean, with the rotated orange-gradient mark

shape.focus: Linear-style ring (inset brand stroke + outer halo)

motif: the lightbulb mark (assets/bulb.svg, drawn in currentColor) + a soft orange radial glow — Brite is a lighting company, so lean on light/glow for motion, not generic gradients
